create_VizierController: create a VizierController to run Vizier-suggested hyperparameters across multiple work units
run_VizierController: run the VizierController to periodically sync status between Vizier and work units
create_WorkUnitVizierUpdater: create a WorkUnitVizierUpdater to sync completion state between a work unit and a Vizier trial
check_for_completion_WorkUnitVizierUpdat: check for completion of a work unit and sync its status with the Vizier trial
complete_trial_WorkUnitVizierUpdater: complete a Vizier trial and mark the associated work unit as finished
